scope: Targeted static local/remote issue and execution architecture, selected issue CRUD/bulk/relation/assignee/schema writers, MCP modes/context/session delegation, local workspace create/link/delete, execution start/monitor/stop/reset/startup recovery, selected approval/queue/log/summary/notification/sync/authentication paths, current retired project UI route and selected mutation hooks, deployment/license declarations and selected unit assertions. Not every-line, full executor/provider/relay/SSH/cryptographic/OAuth/file/preview/terminal/cleanup/all-migrations/security/browser/runtime/scaling certification.

lifecycle_review.create: Remote issue SQL creation transaction with optional client UUID/txid; creator follow-up separate. Local workspace record/repos/attachments/session/process and remote link separate commits/effects; link error can follow successful agent launch.
lifecycle_review.select: Structured remote search/status/assignee/parent filters, not authoritative ready selection. Blocking edges and parent pointers are record relationships; selected schema excludes self-links/duplicate edges without dependency cycle or readiness gate.
lifecycle_review.claim: Multiple issue/user memberships and linked workspaces. First-workspace status propagation and empty-assignee default are read-then-write, not exclusive claim/CAS. No issue lease, owner generation or reserved capacity in inspected launch/write paths.
lifecycle_review.progress: Workspace/session/execution/turn/provider session and message IDs distinct; raw JSONL local logs, status, exit codes, last-assistant summaries and before/after HEAD references. Process records created Running before OS spawn; selected pre-spawn errors can leave pending state. Same-workspace sessions share worktrees.
lifecycle_review.review: Orchestrator MCP starts child sessions and inspects IDs but has no durable result join. Approval questions/tool permissions have typed outcomes and timeouts in memory; not task acceptance. Project UI mounts export-only sunset page at pin.
lifecycle_review.complete: OS exit/executor signal drive process status; closed executor channel assumes success. ID-only completion update plus read-before-write stopped check; remote issue/bulk/status sync writers have no expected owner/revision or accepted-child/reviewer/evidence gate. All-linked-PR-merged check also true for no linked PRs in local merge sync.
lifecycle_review.cancel: Local stop marks terminal before cancellation/group kill; failures can persist changed DB status. Workspace stop helper logs errors and HTTP returns success. Deletion running check separate from delete and later cleanup; queued follow-up is single volatile replaceable item discarded on failure/kill.
lifecycle_review.recover: Startup marks remaining Running records Failed rather than reattaching OS process/lease. Follow-up resumes provider IDs; reset validates process/session but reconciles files before best-effort stop and ignores reset outcome before soft-dropping history. Notification/remote sync errors logged outside original transaction; process maps, approvals and queue local/volatile; no durable distributed execution authority established.
